name: Federated Learning Unit
description: One learning unit holds progression, activities and assessment while referring to separately owned knowledge. Projects to Ekole without replacing canonical Kristal state.
reference_use_case: Ekole-driven learning program backed by Framework v11 educational Kristals.
integrity_rule: The learning unit never owns the referenced sources. Reading projection Ekole is always derived and is not a source of doctrinal truth.
antipattern: Never convert a saint’s hagiography into factual proof, place textual labels as canonical graph IDs, or treat a generated lesson as the original Kristal.
design_question: Which unit owns the pedagogical structure, which Kristals own the religious sources, and which pinned logical states does Ekole read?
structure_label: Unit with referenced knowledge and derived lesson
situational_schema: Learning objective branches into source-linked activities and assessment; a separate publication projection targets Ekole.
case_examples: Catholic message and miracle paths in Ekole
